simple.meaning: to stray (causatively, mislead ), usually (figuratively) to mistake , especially (morally) to transgress ; by extension (through the idea of intoxication) to reel , (figuratively) be enraptured

definitions.short: to stray (causatively, mislead ), usually (figuratively) to mistake , especially (morally) to transgress ; by extension (through the idea of intoxication) to reel , (figuratively) be enraptured
definitions.usage: (cause to) go astray, deceive, err, be ravished, sin through ignorance, (let, make to) wander.
definitions.full: H7686. shagah [ שָׁגָה ] verb go astray, err (Aramaic שְׁגָא , id. ); — Qal Perfect 1singular שָׁגִיתִי Job 6:24 ; 19:4 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׁגֶּה Prov 5:23 , etc.; Infinitive construct שְׁגוֺת 19:27 ; Participle שֹׁגֶה Ezek 45:20 ; Prov 20:1 , etc.; — 1 err, stray , of flock Ezek 34:6 (figurative). 2 swerve, meander, reel or roll , in drunkenness, ב of drink Isa 28:7 (twice in verse); = be intoxicated , Prov 20:1 ; so with ( בּ ) love 5:19-20 , ׳שׁ בָּרֹאֶה Isa 28:7 . 3 go astay , morally, 1Sam 26:21 ; Prov 5:23 ; Job 6:24 ; 19:4 , + 1Sam 14:24 (reading ׳שׁ שְׁגָגָה ) Th We Dr Now (after ᵐ5 ; otherwise Bu HPS); with מן , of ׳י s commands Psa 119:21 ; 119:118 , מִן of words of knowledge Prov 19:27 . 4 specifically commit sin of ignorance , inadvertence Lev 4:13 ; Num 15:22 (P) Ezek 45:20 (compare שׁגג ). Hiph`il lead astray: 1 literal, Participle מַשְׁגֶּה Deut 27:18 ( בַּדֶּרֶךְ ). 2 ׳מַשׁ mentally = mislead Job 12:16 . 3 morally , Participle Prov 28:10 ( רָ֑ע בְּדֶרֶךְ ); Imperfect 2masculine singular suffix תַּשְׁגֵּנִי , with מן of God's commands Psa 119:10 ; + perhaps Job 12:23 leadeth nations astray ( ᵐ5 SvrVer, i.e. וַיַּשְׁגֵּם for וַיַּנְחֵם ).
